properties.name: vor 1900
properties.notes: Pre-industrial / Wilhelmine. PAK from coal tar high; lime mortars; structural variance very high.
Industrialisation; reinforced concrete commercialised; PAK still high; some early asbestos products.

properties.name: Nachkrieg 1945–1970
properties.notes: Wiederaufbau / Wirtschaftswunder. Highest asbestos use; PCB sealants begin; mineral wool widely installed.
Still high asbestos / PCB / KMF; energy crisis drives insulation upgrades; first heavy-metal restrictions.
Country-specific asbestos bans (DE 1993, NL 1994, FR 1997, BE 1998, UK 2000); KMF biopersistence rules tighten.

properties.name: nach 2000
properties.notes: Modern. Asbestos banned across EU/EEA; tight formaldehyde emission limits.

properties.asbest_note: No federal ban; NESHAP demolition/renovation inspection rules apply from 1973
